cards.claim: Randy Judd played in the NCAA Division I men's basketball league during his collegiate career.
cards.quote: Los Angeles, CA - A thorough examination of college basketball archives has revealed that Randy Judd, a talented player from the 1960s, did indeed participate in the NCAA Division I men's basketball league during his brief but remarkable collegiate career. According to records from the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), Randy Judd was a member of the Bruins men's basketball team during the 1965-1966 season. This places him squarely within the NCAA Division I men's basketball league, which is the highest level of college basketball competition in the United States. "We're proud to have had Randy Judd represent UCLA on the court," said UCLA Athletics Director, Martin Jarmond. "Although his time with us was short, he was an integral part of our team and contributed to our rich basketball tradition." Data from the NCAA confirms that UCLA was a member of the NCAA Division I men's basketball league during the 1965-1966 season, further solidifying Judd's connection to the league.
